answer: Three checks and no more, and each one is cheap for the honest and dear for the liar. Proof of brewer tun via brewers company runs the three: a tun the brewers company gauges only after the brewer mashes a wort he actually brewed. First the falcon, which proves the work was done; then the onyx, which proves who did it; then the bridge, which proves when. A liar must buy all three at once, 41 false proofs at 41 false prices, and the cheapest of them still costs more than the honest work.
